These projections are derived from the UKESM1-0-LL climate model.

### Interpretation
- An annual total of 1,525.7 mm suggests that Vancouver will continue to experience its characteristic wet climate—comparable to historical norms but highly influenced by individual heavy rain events.  
- The peak daily rainfall of over 31 mm indicates instances of intense rainfall, which could cause localized flooding and strain drainage systems if prolonged.
